goal: Reduce the complete cost of reading a fixed 256-coordinate edit at Qwen3.5-9B layer 28. No claim about an update made before future questions.
exposure: Same eight exposed 4-bit stream9 seeds 27112000..27112007, table/prose and target/nuisance times written/unwritten. Sixty-four separately charged services per method, full vocabulary top token. No independent cohort opened.
changes: Stop donor prefill at the raw QKV output supplying the 256 written values (run the exact lower layers and same full input shape). Use the existing fused four-slot dual-state geometry. Test one analytic maximizer of the first-order Taylor approximation to the actual normalized-read objective under the same 60-degree cone and Euclidean query norm, retaining the better of that maximizer and the native query under the true finite objective. Compare four ordinary projected-gradient steps, the full sixteen-step solver with identical shortened donor, the original sixteen-step solver with complete donor, and an unmodified query.
controls: Every candidate gets the same write, query norm and angular budget and same model inputs. Check actual donor bytes across all methods, truncated-vs-full solver answers and rendered queries, every nuisance and unwritten answer, query constraints after casting within 0.01 tolerance and top-token gains/losses. Independent full request time includes both source computations, extracting/editing state, dual-state design where needed, and final full-vocabulary read. Time each rotated arm as an independent service after warmup. Do not charge a missing reference to any arm or credit complete-model savings from a solver microbenchmark.
gate: For each approximation require >=95% of the full reader's target successes, no new control error, and >=20% lower mean complete time relative to the matched shortened-donor 16-step reader; report comparison with the original full donor separately. Exact donor truncation may promote separately if bytes, answers and queries all agree with the original and complete time falls >=20%. Show seed bootstrap intervals. No trained predictor unless there is measured avoidable service cost beyond substituting a zero-cost solve. No router without observed complementary wins.
budget: Local 9B Apple M5, 12 minutes plus one implementation repair; no paid charges. Subsequent NVIDIA measurements are eligible if the full-service gate passes.
